capabilities: Display monthly and weekly calendar views of events and meeting notes
Create daily notes, meeting notes, and events from calendar clicks, ribbon icons, or command palette commands
Drag, resize, duplicate, and delete event blocks in the weekly time grid
Show a compact sidebar mini-calendar with an upcoming events list
Recognize existing notes in configured folders via frontmatter date and time fields
extras: README is written in Korean. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Templates are optional; built-in defaults are used if template files are missing.

problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view for scheduling events and meetings alongside daily notes, requiring several separate plugins.
